description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Omnath's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
